svg.title: Chengyu of the day: 亡羊补牢 (traditional 亡羊補牢), wáng yáng bǔ láo, “Lost a sheep, mend the pen”. Write the postmortem and fix the gap, even after the outage. It's not too late. The characters write themselves in stroke by stroke, in Simplified and then in Traditional.

g.text: Write the postmortem and fix the gap, even after
the outage. It's not too late.
in real stroke order · a new one every day
strokes: animCJK · Make Me a Hanzi
